name: vault
description: An end-to-end encrypted password vault for a ForkMesh account, with logins shared to users and organizations under X25519 and post-quantum ML-KEM-768 keys.

interface.shortDescription: End-to-end encrypted logins you can share with users and organizations.
interface.longDescription: Create a vault for your own account with a master password that never leaves your browser. Logins are encrypted before they are uploaded, so ForkMesh stores only ciphertext. Share one with a ForkMesh user or an organization: its key is sealed to each person's public keys with a hybrid of X25519 and ML-KEM-768 and signed by you. The ForkMesh browser extension fills and saves logins from the same vault.
defaultPrompt: How do I share a login with my organization?
What happens if I forget my master password?
What can ForkMesh see in my vault?
